mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM fin_bill WHERE kind = #{billKind} AND partner_id = #{partnerId} AND bill_date < #{date}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount + discount_amount), 0) FROM fin_settlement WHERE kind = #{settleKind} AND partner_id = #{partnerId} AND status = 'APPROVED' AND settle_date < #{date}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM fin_advance WHERE kind = #{settleKind} AND partner_id = #{partnerId} AND advance_date < #{date}

SELECT t.biz_date AS "bizDate", t.type AS "type", t.doc_no AS "docNo", t.source_type AS "sourceType", t.source_no AS "sourceNo", t.amount AS "amount", t.remark AS "remark" FROM ( SELECT b.bill_date AS biz_date, 'BILL' AS type, 1 AS seq, b.bill_no AS doc_no, b.source_type AS source_type, b.source_no AS source_no, b.amount AS amount, b.remark AS remark, b.id AS id FROM fin_bill b WHERE b.kind = #{billKind} AND b.partner_id = #{partnerId} AND b.bill_date >= #{begin} AND b.bill_date <= #{end} UNION ALL SELECT s.settle_date, 'SETTLEMENT', 2, s.settle_no, s.method, NULL, s.amount + s.discount_amount, s.remark, s.id FROM fin_settlement s WHERE s.kind = #{settleKind} AND s.partner_id = #{partnerId} AND s.status = 'APPROVED' AND s.settle_date >= #{begin} AND s.settle_date <= #{end} UNION ALL SELECT a.advance_date, 'ADVANCE', 3, a.advance_no, a.method, NULL, a.amount, a.remark, a.id FROM fin_advance a WHERE a.kind = #{settleKind} AND a.partner_id = #{partnerId} AND a.advance_date >= #{begin} AND a.advance_date <= #{end} UNION ALL
SELECT n.netting_date, 'NETTING', 4, n.netting_no, NULL, NULL, n.amount, n.remark, n.id FROM fin_netting n WHERE n.customer_idn.supplier_id = #{partnerId} AND n.netting_date >= #{begin} AND n.netting_date <= #{end} ) t ORDER BY t.biz_date, t.seq, t.id
SELECT r.* FROM () r ORDER BY r.net DESC, r.partner_id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.opening), 0) AS opening, COALESCE(SUM(r.bill_balance), 0) AS bill_balance, COALESCE(SUM(r.advance_balance), 0) AS advance_balance, COALESCE(SUM(r.bad_debt), 0) AS bad_debt, COALESCE(SUM(r.discount), 0) AS discount, COALESCE(SUM(r.linked_ap), 0) AS linked_ap, COALESCE(SUM(r.net), 0) AS net FROM () r
